project_info.theme: Early-2000s direct-flash hallway outfit portrait in pale pink satin
project_info.color_palette: pale pink, white beadboard, medium wood, dark hallway shadows and warm tungsten

main_subject.detail: Adult woman with long voluminous blonde hair in loose waves, fair skin with a soft rosy glow, prominent blush, defined eyebrows and glossy lips. She stands in a relaxed posed stance, leaning slightly against the wall with one hand on the wainscoting ledge, one leg straight and the other knee bent forward. She wears a pale-pink monochromatic ensemble: a strapless satin corset top with ruffled detailing and boning structure, a matching short layered ruffled skirt with sheer decorative elements, knee-high pale-pink lace-up platform boots and a small structured pale-pink handbag.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-photorealistic full-body portrait of an adult woman with long voluminous blonde hair styled in loose waves, fair skin with a soft rosy glow, prominent blush, defined eyebrows and glossy lips. She stands in a relaxed but posed stance, leaning slightly against a wall with her right hand resting on the wainscoting ledge, left leg straight and right knee bent and popped forward, projecting confidence and playful style. She wears a pale pink monochromatic ensemble featuring a strapless satin corset top with ruffled detailing and boning structure, a matching short layered ruffled skirt with sheer decorative elements, knee-high pale pink lace-up platform boots with chunky soles and a small structured pale pink handbag. Set the scene in a narrow indoor hallway with white beadboard wainscoting, plain white plaster, medium-toned wooden flooring, visible dark wooden ceiling beams, a closed white door or wall panel and an electrical outlet on the left wall. Use direct on-camera flash combined with warm ambient tungsten overhead light, creating a vintage paparazzi or early-2000s digital-camera aesthetic, distinct wall shadow and highlighted satin sheen. Eye-level 35mm perspective, slight vignette, high contrast, sharp focus, realistic skin texture and cinematic flash photography. Preserve the playful Y2K soft-glam outfit and hallway snapshot intent.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, transparent clothing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, distorted hands, duplicate handbag
